## FAQs

Everything you need to know about the product and billing. Can't find the answer you're looking for? Please chat to our friendly team.


Is there a free trial available?


Yes! You can, of course, try our software for free for 14 days without providing any credit card information. Try out an account by pressing the "Try for free" button or by scheduling a demo.


Why do organizations choose Formalize over traditional compliance tools?


Organizations choose Formalize when they want to move beyond spreadsheets and fragmented compliance systems.


Formalize provides a structured compliance operations platform where risks, controls, incidents, policies, and supplier activities are connected in one place. This makes compliance easier to manage, scale, and audit without the complexity typically associated with traditional GRC platforms.


Teams gain full visibility into their compliance posture while reducing manual work and improving consistency across frameworks.


How many users are included?


You can add as many users as necessary. You can invite both internal and external people, such as law firms or consultants. Once you invite users, they will gain authorized access to the system.


What support do we get in the implementation process?


Our award-winning customer support team is ready to assist you in the process of implementation of Formalize in your organisation. You will be scheduled for an onboarding meeting where we can answer all your questions and help you navigate through the system. However, the platform is user-friendly and easy to use even without our help.


Which standards and regulations does Formalize support?


Formalize supports ISO 27001, NIS2, DORA, GDPR (including RoPA, Data Subject Requests, TIAs, DPIAs), ISMS, and broader GRC programs. The system is built to manage multiple frameworks simultaneously and adapt to organizational structure, processes, and data models.


Does Formalize offer customizable automation?


Yes. Formalize adapts to each organization's structure, language, branding, data model, and compliance needs. Users can customize dashboards, questionnaires, templates, workflows, permissions, and Trust Center content to match internal processes and industry requirements.


Who typically relies on Formalize?


Formalize is used by compliance professionals, security leaders, auditors, and consultants responsible for managing regulatory requirements.


It is particularly valuable for organizations working with frameworks such as ISO 27001, NIS2, DORA, and GDPR, and for teams that need a structured, scalable approach to compliance operations across multiple frameworks.


Formalize supports companies at different stages: from growing organizations building their compliance foundation to enterprises managing complex regulatory environments.


Where is Formalize used and what types of organizations use the platform?


Formalize is used by organizations in more than 80 countries, supporting compliance for millions of employees globally.


It is especially relevant for:


- European companies navigating regulations such as NIS2 and DORA

- International organizations operating across multiple jurisdictions

- Mid-market and enterprise companies managing multiple compliance frameworks


The platform is designed to adapt to different industries and regulatory requirements, making it suitable for both regional and global compliance operations.


When does Formalize become the right compliance solution?


Formalize becomes the right solution when organizations move beyond single-framework compliance and need a more structured approach.


This typically happens when:


- Managing multiple frameworks like ISO 27001, GDPR, and NIS2

- Scaling compliance across teams, departments, or regions

- Replacing spreadsheets or disconnected tools

- Needing continuous compliance instead of point-in-time audits


At this stage, organizations benefit from a unified platform that connects all compliance activities and supports long-term scalability.
